architectureDecisions: CausalObservation is a derived immutable snapshot/read model, never an authority object; production authority remains in B-G artifacts and currentness heads.
Current observation pins one exact ProductProjectionSubject plus the canonical heads needed for unresolved work. A mixed-time graph cannot be labeled CURRENT.

The causal graph contains typed nodes/edges backed by exact refs: obligation/derivation/currentness, work/claim/release, execution policy/strategy/binding/attestation/outcome/decision/publication, deployment/QA and product closure.
Remaining-work ownership resolves from current CrossDomainObligation + OrganizationWorkContract/Board subject; observer never derives next-role ordering.
Execution provenance is reconstructed from ExecutionJudgmentBundle and re-resolved pinned artifacts; executionAttemptId and runtimeInvocationId remain distinct across recovery.

Quality/closure provenance is reconstructed through DeploymentRelease -> AcceptanceSnapshot -> RuntimeObservationEvidence -> QualityAcceptance -> ProductProjectionSubject/ProductStateProjection -> ProductOutcomeClaim.
Missing required provenance is a typed MISSING_PROVENANCE node and yields UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE answers; no LLM/prose inference participates in factual reconstruction.

Waiting/execution metrics use producer-owned durable timing facts. A first-write-wins CausalTimingMarker keyed by canonical event subject captures materialization/release milestones; runtime startedAt/finishedAt come from RuntimeExecutionAttestation. Old subjects without timing markers remain UNKNOWN.
Observation indexes are rebuildable accelerators only. Deleting indexes/caches and replaying exact canonical refs must reconstruct the same normalized graph.
BB-058 research may consume BB-057 READY as planned dependency; WORKER waits for BB-057 DONE and validates the delivered recovered-path provenance before claiming observation completeness.
implementationSlices: I1 — Timing provenance [AC-8, INV-7]: add causal-timing.js with stable event subject keys and first-write-wins immutable timing markers using an injected trusted clock. Organization materialization/release producers record markers without changing semantic artifact identity; retries reuse the existing marker. Runtime duration uses existing attestation startedAt/finishedAt. Missing legacy markers remain UNKNOWN.

I2 — Pinned observation subject [AC-1, AC-6, AC-7, INV-2, INV-5, INV-9]: add causal-observation.js build({productId,rootIntentRef}) that pins the exact ProductProjectionSubject and current unresolved-work heads, rejects mixed-time current graphs, and stores a content-addressed CausalObservation snapshot.

I3 — Product/ownership causality [AC-1, AC-2, INV-4, INV-6]: traverse current ProductStateProjection, SemanticClaim/CrossDomainObligation heads, ProductDerivationEdge and OrganizationWorkContract/Board state to derive why-not-done, exact blocker cause and owning work/domain. No next-role/priority/order output.

I4 — Execution provenance [AC-3, AC-5, AC-10, INV-3]: resolve ExecutionJudgmentBundle pins through WorkContract, claim release, policy, strategy, binding, runtime attestations, outcome, completion, publication and transition history. Preserve semantic attempt vs runtime invocation and emit MISSING_PROVENANCE instead of inference.

I5 — Acceptance/closure provenance [AC-4, AC-5, INV-3, INV-8]: resolve DeploymentRelease, AcceptanceSnapshot, RuntimeObservationEvidence, QualityAcceptance, ProductProjectionSubject/Projection and ProductOutcomeClaim into typed supporting-evidence edges while distinguishing historical from current evidence.

I6 — Answers + deterministic rebuild [AC-1..AC-10, INV-1..INV-9]: expose read-only queries whyNotDone/remainingOwners/failedObligations/executionProvenance/timing/supportingEvidence; rebuild from durable stores in a fresh process, delete caches/indexes, and compare normalized graph/answers exactly. Run B-H regressions.
